Regime Risk & Model Validation

Energy regimes, volatility, VaR/ES backtests and commodity factor validation · daily data to 2026-09-22

Risk report (PDF)Factor report (PDF)GitHub
OverviewRegimesVolatilityVaR backtestsFactor replicationOverfitting checks

Two workflows, one question: can we trust the numbers? The first tracks volatility regimes in energy benchmarks and backtests five VaR/ES models out of sample. The second rebuilds three published commodity factor strategies and checks them for overfitting.
